description: This file defines interfaces for plugin management within the Thunder framework, including plugin lifecycle, notifications, web communication, WebSocket, security, and authentication interfaces.

classes.name: IPlugin
classes.description: Main plugin interface with lifecycle methods and notification/lifetime sub-interfaces.

classes.name: IPluginExtended
classes.description: Extended plugin interface supporting WebSocket channel attachment.

classes.name: ICompositPlugin
classes.description: Interface for composite plugins with callback registration.

classes.name: IWeb
classes.description: Interface for handling web requests and responses.

classes.name: IChannel
classes.description: Interface for raw data channel communication.

classes.name: ISecurity
classes.description: Interface for security validation of requests and WebSocket upgrades.

classes.name: IAuthenticate
classes.description: Interface for token creation and security officer retrieval.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Called to initialize a plugin with configuration data.

methods.name: Deinitialize
methods.description: Called to deinitialize and unload a plugin.

methods.name: Information
methods.description: Returns plugin metadata as a JSON string.

methods.name: Attach
methods.description: Attach a WebSocket channel to the plugin.

methods.name: Detach
methods.description: Detach a WebSocket channel from the plugin.

methods.name: Callback
methods.description: Register a callback with the plugin.

methods.name: Inbound
methods.description: Handle incoming web request or WebSocket message.

methods.name: Process
methods.description: Process a web request and generate a response.

methods.name: Inbound
methods.description: Handle incoming WebSocket JSON message with identifier.

methods.name: Inbound
methods.description: Handle raw data received on a channel.

methods.name: Outbound
methods.description: Send raw data over a channel.

methods.name: Allowed
methods.description: Check if a WebSocket upgrade or request is allowed.

methods.name: Officer
methods.description: Retrieve security officer interface for a token.
